Quintessential

kwin-tuh-SEN-shul -- from quintessence ('the purest, most concentrated essence of something') + -ial. · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

To be quintessential is to be the single best or most perfect example of its kind.

With its red phone booths, black cabs, and steady drizzle, the scene captured the quintessential image of London.

Worked Example

Ordering a slice at a corner shop, cheese dripping off the edge as you eat it folded in half on the sidewalk, is the quintessential New York pizza experience.

Quintessential marks something as the single best, most representative example of its category -- not just a good example, but the example that everyone would picture first.

Compare the words

Synonyms · words with a similar meaning

archetypal: serving as the original, typical model of something

classic: widely recognized as the standard example of its kind

What it isn’t · antonyms and near-opposites

atypical: not representative of the usual type

unrepresentative: not typical of the group or category

Where it sits · how fully it represents its kind — typical → quintessential → archetypal

typical vs. quintessential: Typical simply means common or usual.

archetypal vs. quintessential: Archetypal is nearly identical to quintessential, emphasizing that something serves as the original model others are compared to.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — quintessent-

root — quintessent-: the purest, most concentrated essence of something (Latin quinta essentia, 'fifth essence')

suffix — -ial

suffix — -ial: having the qualities of; pertaining to

Put it together

Put it together: Quintessential comes from quintessence -- Latin quinta essentia, literally 'fifth essence,' once believed to be the purest substance in the universe -- plus -ial. Something quintessential is the single most representative, purest example of its category.

Use the root in a new word: quintessence

Use the root in a new word: quintessence: Fans called the guitarist's final solo the quintessence of rock and roll -- the purest, most concentrated version of everything the genre stands for.

Word Choice

Quintessential should be reserved for the single best or most representative example of a category -- not used loosely for something that's merely 'pretty good' or 'somewhat typical.'
